mapper.sql: c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_code, c.contact_person, c.contact_phone, c.shop_dept_id, sd.dept_name shop_dept_name, c.status, p.photo_node_id, p.tea_preferences, p.preference_tags, p.brewing_service_preferences, p.cautions, p.budget_min, p.budget_max, p.last_visit_date, coalesce(p.version, 0) version, c.create_by, c.create_time, coalesce(p.update_by, c.update_by, c.create_by) update_by, coalesce(p.update_time, c.update_time, c.create_time) update_time
from inv_customer c left join inv_customer_service_profile p on p.customer_id = c.customer_id left join sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = c.shop_dept_id
mapper.select:
select customer_id, customer_name, customer_code, contact_phone, status from inv_customer where shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and status = '0'
and (customer_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or contact_phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or customer_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by customer_name, customer_id desc limit 200

select where c.shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and c.status = #{status}
and (c.customer_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.contact_phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.customer_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.tea_preferences like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.preference_tags like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.brewing_service_preferences like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.cautions like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and concat(',', coalesce(p.preference_tags, ''), ',') like concat('%,', #{preferenceTag}, ',%')
order by coalesce(p.last_visit_date, c.create_time) desc, c.customer_id desc
select count(1) from inv_customer_service_profile where customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.insert: insert into inv_customer_service_profile ( customer_id, photo_node_id, tea_preferences, preference_tags, brewing_service_preferences, cautions, budget_min, budget_max, last_visit_date, version, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{customerId}, #{photoNodeId}, #{teaPreferences}, #{preferenceTags}, #{brewingServicePreferences}, #{cautions}, #{budgetMin}, #{budgetMax}, #{lastVisitDate}, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update inv_customer_service_profile set photo_node_id = #{photoNodeId}, tea_preferences = #{teaPreferences}, preference_tags = #{preferenceTags}, brewing_service_preferences = #{brewingServicePreferences}, cautions = #{cautions}, budget_min = #{budgetMin}, budget_max = #{budgetMax}, last_visit_date = #{lastVisitDate}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where customer_id = #{customerId} and version = #{version}

update inv_customer set customer_name = #{customerName}, customer_code = #{customerCode}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where customer_id = #{customerId} and status = '0'
update inv_customer set status = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where customer_id = #{customerId} and status != '1'
mapper.insert: insert into inv_customer_service_record ( customer_id, service_date, service_user_id, service_user_name, party_size, tea_served, preference_snapshot, caution_snapshot, service_note, consumption_amount, shop_dept_id, request_key, source_client, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{customerId}, #{serviceDate}, #{serviceUserId}, #{serviceUserName}, #{partySize}, #{teaServed}, #{preferenceSnapshot}, #{cautionSnapshot}, #{serviceNote}, #{consumptionAmount}, #{shopDeptId}, #{requestKey}, #{sourceClient}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select record_id from inv_customer_service_record where customer_id = #{customerId} and request_key = #{requestKey} limit 1

select record_id, customer_id, service_date, service_user_id, service_user_name, party_size, tea_served, preference_snapshot, caution_snapshot, service_note, consumption_amount, shop_dept_id, request_key, source_client, create_by, create_time from inv_customer_service_record where customer_id = #{customerId} order by service_date desc, record_id desc limit 100
select coalesce(max(record_id),0) from inv_customer_service_record where customer_id = #{customerId} and shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId}
select log_id from inv_customer_service_change_log where customer_id = #{customerId} and request_key = #{requestKey} limit 1
select customer_id from inv_customer_service_change_log where shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and request_key = #{requestKey} and change_type = 'CREATE' order by log_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into inv_customer_service_change_log ( customer_id, request_key, change_type, changed_fields, before_summary, after_summary, operator_user_id, operator_name, shop_dept_id, source_client, create_time ) values ( #{customerId}, #{requestKey}, #{changeType}, #{changedFields}, #{beforeSummary}, #{afterSummary}, #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{shopDeptId}, #{sourceClient}, sysdate() )
